summary: ICICI Bank filed a Form 6-K disclosing the pricing of USD 750 million senior unsecured fixed-rate notes under its USD 7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme. The notes carry a 5.417% coupon, mature August 21, 2031, and will be listed on IFSC exchanges and SGX-ST. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. No takeover, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. The filing is regulatory disclosure under Indian listing rules, with no deal terms applicable.
